pin_regs.reason: Every public pin is registered IN THE SOURCE (checklist 1): each input pin lands first in a flop D pin and each output is driven by a flop (or a tie constant) -- tools/qwen_kv_die/attn_pinreg_1019/check_pinreg.py PASS on qkd_kvs_attn_safe_pr.v; io_flop_at_pins anchors those flops at the face. A kit recipe-3 pin register would add an unpriced edge to every crossing.

structural_change: SAFE ATTN (KV-ATTN 10-19): safe-control native source 6326ff81a (6040 FF, every non-clock driver <=24 loads, fin <=22) + pin registration (tools/qwen_kv_die/attn_pinreg_1019/pinreg.py: 17 RX zero-test flops retimed onto the existing RX landing flops, 2 ufk fault-root flops split per pin; every input pin -> flop D, every output <- flop (or tie constant), ZERO added edges; lockstep equivalence vs 6326ff81a on all outputs + all 6040 flop nets). Geometry: 216 x 216 um (accepted bounded model ffb895c67: pin-limited faces at <=5.2 pins/um, 0.192 um pin pitch); clock at the S-face centre feeding the local spine. Replaces ba4 805aa57cb (fin_q 1038 / codec 529 / i_ctl 436 loads, legacy reset 256).
